bio: A pleasant stroll in Cambridge’s historic city centre, The Fellows House is perfect for an indulgent Afternoon Tea followed by a gentle stroll to explore the city.  Situated near Jesus Green, a pleasant stroll into Cambridge’s historic city centre, The Fellows House is at the crossroads of the old and new: the heritage of the storied university city, and the vibrancy of Silicon Fen – its innovation cluster.  Afternoon Tea at The Fellows House is certainly a special occasion in this legendary city. Deeply inspired by the city’s history, you will find nods to the great ‘Fellows’ of the University of Cambridge in the curated artwork of the lobby, restaurant and bar.  And on the menu? Served on a 3-tiered stand are all the hallmarks of a quintessential Afternoon Tea – homemade scones, finger sandwiches and sweet treats, masterfully crafted by the in-house Pastry Chef. Not to mention an exquisite selection of loose leaf teas. For a special treat, pair your experience with a glass of sparkling wine.  Afternoon Tea is served every Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday from 12pm to 4:30pm.
